name: semanticscript
description: Agent-first SemanticScript toolchain: compile, lint, and analyze .sem source through stable JSON surfaces.
long_description: Exposes the SemanticScript `sem` CLI's stable JSON surfaces (check, readiness, context, symbols, graph, slice, explain, fix plan, patch, test, and more) as MCP tools, backed by the bundled single-file `sem` executable.
